title: E-commerce Order API
objective: Model checkout and the order lifecycle.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Products, carts, orders, and order items
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate products, carts, orders, and order items in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Server-side price and inventory validation
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate server-side price and inventory validation in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Valid order state transitions and cancellation rules
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate valid order state transitions and cancellation rules in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Idempotent creation, ownership, transactions, and failure tests
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate idempotent creation, ownership, transactions, and failure tests in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Products, carts, orders, and order items
Valid order state transitions and cancellation rules
Idempotent creation, ownership, transactions, and failure tests
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
